extracted.intended_audience: applicants, patent attorneys, and draftsmen preparing drawings for European patent applications (EPC)
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements for the form and presentation of drawings in European patent applications under EPC Rule 46, covering sheet size, margins, line and lettering quality, arrangement and use of reference signs, permissible text, scale and reproduction requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Usable surface area and prohibition of frames
rubrics_metrics.description: On sheets containing drawings, the usable surface area shall not exceed 26.2 cm x 17 cm. The usable or used surface shall not be surrounded by frames.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the drawing content fits within 26.2 x 17 cm and do not enclose the used area in a frame. See also related EPO guidelines on usable surface area of sheets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum margins
rubrics_metrics.description: The minimum margins shall be as follows: top 2.5 cm; left side 2.5 cm; right side 1.5 cm; bottom 1 cm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe these margin sizes on all sheets containing drawings so that no drawing elements or reference signs fall within the margins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Line colour and quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings shall be executed without colourings in durable, black, sufficiently dense and dark, uniformly thick and well-defined lines and strokes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use black, durable media or printing so lines reproduce clearly. Avoid colour and uneven/thin strokes that would reduce clarity upon reproduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hatching for cross-sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Cross-sections shall be indicated by hatching which should not impede the clear reading of the reference signs and leading lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply hatching patterns that distinguish materials or sections but do not obscure reference numerals, labels, or leader lines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scale and graphical representation of scale
rubrics_metrics.description: The scale of the drawings and their graphical execution shall be such that electronic or photographic reproduction with a linear reduction in size to two-thirds will allow all details to be distinguished without difficulty. If, exceptionally, the scale is given on a drawing, it shall be represented graphically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare drawings so that a 2/3 linear reduction still leaves all details legible. If indicating a scale, include a graphical scale bar rather than or in addition to a numeric ratio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numbers, letters and reference signs clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: All numbers, letters, and reference signs appearing on the drawings shall be simple and clear. Brackets, circles or inverted commas shall not be used in association with numbers and letters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use clear, simple lettering and reference signs. Do not surround numbers/letters with brackets, circles or inverted commas; ensure characters are easily read after reproduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of drafting instruments for lines
rubrics_metrics.description: Generally, all lines in the drawings shall be drawn with the aid of drafting instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer mechanically or instrument-drawn lines (rulers, compasses, etc.) over freehand to ensure straight, uniform strokes and professional appearance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proportionality of elements within a figure
rubrics_metrics.description: Elements of the same figure shall be proportional to one another, unless a difference in proportion is indispensable for the clarity of the figure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep relative sizes realistic and proportional, except where deliberate disproportion improves understanding (e.g., enlarged detail insets).

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum height of numbers and letters; alphabets to use
rubrics_metrics.description: The height of the numbers and letters shall not be less than 0.32 cm. For the lettering of drawings, the Latin and, where customary, the Greek alphabets shall be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure lettering meets the minimum 0.32 cm height requirement and use Latin (and Greek where customary) characters to maintain legibility and compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrangement of multiple figures and figure numbering
rubrics_metrics.description: The same sheet of drawings may contain several figures. Where figures drawn on two or more sheets are intended to form a single figure, the figures on the several sheets shall be so arranged that the whole figure can be assembled without concealing any part of the partial figures. The different figures shall be arranged without wasting space, preferably in an upright position, clearly separated from one another. Where the figures are not arranged in an upright position, they shall be presented sideways with the top of the figures at the left side of the sheet. The different figures shall be numbered consecutively in Arabic numerals, independently of the numbering of the sheets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place multiple figures efficiently and upright where possible; when spanning sheets, design them to be assembled into a whole without overlap. Number figures consecutively with Arabic numerals regardless of sheet numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistency of reference signs between drawings, description and claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference signs not mentioned in the description and claims shall not appear in the drawings, and vice versa. Reference signs to features shall be consistent throughout the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the same reference numerals/letters in drawings, description and claims; do not introduce signs in the drawings that are not referenced in the specification or claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Text matter on drawings and permitted keywords
rubrics_metrics.description: The drawings shall not contain text matter. Where indispensable to understand the drawings, a few short keywords, such as "water", "steam", "open", "closed" or "section on AB", may be included. Any such keywords shall be placed in such a way that, if required, they can be replaced by their translations without interfering with any lines of the drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid text on drawings except minimal, essential keywords. Position any words so that translations can be substituted without disturbing drawing lines; keep textual content short and functional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flow sheets and diagrams treated as drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Flow sheets and diagrams shall be deemed to be drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat flow charts, block diagrams and similar schematics as drawings and ensure they comply with the same formal requirements (margins, line quality, lettering, scale, etc.).
